name: ServiceNow · Requests from configuration files
description: Reads requests from a file and uses configuration to select catalog items and fill their variables. Shows the orders for approval, submits them to ServiceNow and reports each outcome, reusing results already recorded.

nodes.title: Validate Request input and prepare plans
nodes.prompt: Read README.md, requests.json and config/catalog-routing.json as data. Do not change Personal Settings or credentials. Run python3 request_batch.py --config config/catalog-routing.json --tickets requests.json --out output/request-plans.json. Inspect each resulting plan: request_id, catalog_route and request_fields must match the input exactly. Do not guess catalog sys_ids, variable names, identity or requested_for; missing configuration is reported by the native connector per Request. Never call ServiceNow or order from a shell.

nodes.title: Report each Request outcome
nodes.prompt: Read output/servicenow-apply-requests.json and requests.json. Report one row per Request with catalog route, applied/reused/blocked/attention_required and the native request number/sys_id where available. Explicitly name configuration files/keys that must be completed; do not suggest editing Personal Settings for catalog details. Do not claim success for blocked or uncertain requests. Do not contact ServiceNow. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s . -p test_examples.py -v.
